title: BESS Lead
description:
**Company Description**

**Work with Us. Change the World.**

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the worldâs most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**

**Core Duties & Responsibilities**

* Review BESS progress, risks and recovery actions covering battery containers, PCS, MV systems, auxiliaries, FSS, EMS/BMS/SCADA control interfaces monitored by the BESS Electrical Engineer, and grid interfaces.
* Provide technical escalation support on battery safety, OEM compliance, warranty, performance tests and availability requirements.
* Coordinate integration dependencies with Solar/Wind generation, grid connectivity, communication networks and energisation plans.
* Review commissioning strategy, performance test criteria and HOTO readiness recommendations from the BESS Site Team Leader.
* Support risk-based decisions for delivery, storage, preservation, installation and energised operations.
* Present consolidated BESS decision requirements to the Program Director and Client.

**Principal Client-Facing Outputs**

* BESS risk and integration governance report.
* Performance-test/readiness recommendation.
* Critical OEM/warranty/interface decision note.

  
**Qualifications**

B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical, Power Electronics, Electronics & Instrumentation or Renewable Energy Engineering; M.Tech preferred.

 **Additional Information**  

* Provide programme-level governance for BESS delivery, integration and performance readiness, ensuring battery safety, OEM interfaces and grid services are addressed through disciplined oversight.
* PMP preferred; BESS/OEM safety training, NFPA 855 / fire safety awareness, grid code, EMS/BMS/SCADA and performance testing training desirable.
* Grid-scale BESS project leadership with knowledge of LFP/containerised systems, PCS/MV interfaces, EMS/BMS/SCADA, FSS, performance testing and warranty management.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

description:

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**

Key Responsibilities

* Review the overall HVDC system architecture, design criteria and technical interfaces.
* Review OEM documents for VSC converters, converter valves, converter transformers and associated auxiliaries.
* Review AC/DC filters, phase reactors, smoothing reactors, harmonic filters and reactive-power equipment.
* Review station control, pole control, valve control, protection, monitoring and sequence-of-events systems.
* Review operating modes, power-control functions, voltage and reactive-power control and system recovery philosophy.
* Review control and protection coordination between the HVDC system, AC substations, grid protection, SCADA and telecom systems.
* Review applicable system studies, including load flow, short circuit, harmonic, insulation coordination, overvoltage, dynamic-performance and electromagnetic-interference studies.
* Verify technical interfaces between converter transformers, valves, cooling systems, control systems and station auxiliaries.
* Review converter hall, valve hall, equipment-layout and environmental requirements.
* Review OEM manufacturing, installation, testing and commissioning procedures.
* Participate in design reviews, interface meetings, model-validation reviews and technical workshops.
* Review control and protection settings, logic diagrams, interlocks, trip matrices and functional specifications.
* Review factory and site testing documentation where included in the contracted scope.
* Support resolution of complex technical issues during installation, testing and system integration.
* Review readiness for subsystem testing, station integration, energization and trial operation.
* Advise the Client on HVDC performance risks, OEM deviations, design gaps and mitigation measures.
* Support review of as-built documentation, operating manuals and training requirements.

Key Deliverables

* HVDC design and OEM-document review comments.
* HVDC interface register.
* Control and protection review report.
* System-study review memorandum.
* HVDC technical-risk register.
* Testing and commissioning-readiness assessment.
* Final HVDC technical-compliance report.

  
**Qualifications**

Minimum Qualification and Experience

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems or Power Electronics.
* Minimum 12 years of experience in HVDC, FACTS, power-electronic converter systems or EHV system integration.
* Demonstrated experience with VSC-HVDC or comparable converter-based transmission systems.
* Knowledge of HVDC control, protection, system studies, converter transformers, valves and harmonic performance.
* Experience in OEM design review, testing and commissioning is preferred.

  
**Additional Information**

title: Lead Welding Engineer
description:
Within the Technology team of Product Engineering, the Welding Engineer supports nuclear business projects with specialist welding and materials knowledge across the whole range of products and services. He/she is part of a team and provides specialist support, in a context of increased complexity of projects and fast changes while maintaining conformity to design intent, codes, standards and quality .
  
Products include steam turbines, heat exchangers, generators and pumps.
  
The role covers new build and service activities.  
Disciplines: Welding, Metallurgy, Materials Science and Engineering.

**1.1 Role & Responsibilities**
-------------------------------

**The role consists in:**

* Support material selection appropriate to equipment design and function.
* Support the maintenance and development of specifications for **welding** within the context of any applied codes and standards, e.g. Pressure Equipment Directive.
* Support the review of supplier derogation requests and non-conformance reports related to welding and heat treatment.
* Support internal manufacturing activities.
* Promote the department’s expertise and uphold company values and ethics.
* Ensure compliance with company-specific **EHS** rules and instructions.

**Responsibilities:**

The Welding Engineer shall:

* Provide support to Products and Services related to welding activities, and design related to welding.
* Support review of technical reports.
* Support the technical assessment of non-conformance reports and supplier derogation requests.
* Participate in cost reduction activities related to material streamlining and harmonization of legacy specifications.
* Develop and introduce new manufacturing technologies.
* Maintain positive interfaces with other technical disciplines.
* Maintain positive interfaces with projects in Products and Services.
* Maintain a positive technical interface with the manufacturing network in Arabelle Solutions and external suppliers in charge of the components manufacturing.
* Provide feedback experience to the group (feedback meetings with suppliers and internal, feedback reports)
* Provide coaching and mentoring of developing Engineers.
* Support supplier improvement and supply chain development.

Join us and work with global teams to support global customers ! At Arabelle Solutions, we have team members of more than 49 nationalities spread across 16 countries.

At Arabelle Solutions, we know diversity makes teams and business stronger.

title: Hardware & Network Engineer
description:
We are looking for a skilled Network Engineer / IT Support Engineer to manage our office IT infrastructure, including internet connectivity, network switches, systems, hardware, and firewall configuration. The candidate will be responsible for troubleshooting and ensuring smooth, secure, and uninterrupted IT operations.

Key Responsibilities

Manage internal office internet connectivity, LAN, Wi-Fi, and network switches.

Configure, monitor, and troubleshoot firewall-related issues.
